subject: Geografia

components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between resource distribution and patterns of human economic or social development

components.description_pt: Comparar papéis de EUA e países BRICS na produção econômica global e circulação
components.description_en: Compare the roles of the United States and BRICS countries in global economic production and circulation
